title: orthocarpus erianthus var. micranthus
intro: Orthocarpus erianthus var. micranthus, commonly known as Purple Monkey Flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Orthocarpus erianthus var. micranthus include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids and phenylethanoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
